shots.visual: A blood-stained sword is thrust into the ground, its blade vibrating with intensity.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 孫權，滾出來受死！

shots.visual: Looking at the massive army surrounding them, his hands are trembling slightly.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，敵軍百萬，我們被包圍了！

shots.visual: Looking straight at the city walls, ignoring the threat behind his back.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 包圍？朕是要將他們一網打盡！

shots.visual: His face turns pale as he realizes the magnitude of the gamble.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 這簡直是以卵擊石，瘋了！

shots.visual: Raising his hand to signal the archers, fire reflecting in his eyes.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 傳令下去，全員攻城，不留後路！

shots.visual: Standing on the city battlements, looking down at the charging Shu army.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 劉備竟然不等援軍？他在找死！

shots.visual: His eyes narrow, sensing something is wrong despite the numerical advantage.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 不對，他哪來的底氣？

shots.visual: Behind him, the Shu army ignites thousands of torches, turning night into day.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 給孫權送戰書！

shots.visual: An arrow with a scroll thuds into the pillar next to his head.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 拿過來！朕倒要看看他寫什麼！

shots.visual: Reading the scroll, his hands start to shake with rage.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 三日內不降，朕便火燒建業！

shots.visual: He tears the scroll into pieces and throws them over the wall.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 狂妄自大！孤有百萬精兵！

shots.visual: Watching the paper scraps fall, a cold smile appears on his face.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 百萬精兵？不過是土雞瓦犬。

shots.visual: Approaching him with an urgent report in hand.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，魏國曹丕也出兵了！

shots.visual: Laughing as he looks at a map showing Shu and Wu clashing.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 等他們兩敗俱傷，天下歸魏！

shots.visual: Eyes flashing with a terrifying, otherworldly intelligence.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 曹丕若敢來，朕連他一起葬了！

shots.visual: Standing in the Shu camp, looking at the city of her birth with mixed emotions.

lines.speaker: sun_shangxiang
lines.text: 皇叔，你真的要毀了東吳嗎？

shots.visual: His voice is cold, showing no room for negotiation.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 是孫權先背叛了朕的信任。

shots.visual: Watching the first wave of Shu soldiers hitting the gate.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 瘋子！他真的開始攻城了！

shots.visual: Suddenly, his fearful expression shifts into a terrifying, manic grin.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 哈哈哈哈！劉備，你上當了！

shots.visual: Realizing something is off as the city gate opens from the inside with no one there.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 空城？這不可能！

shots.visual: His image on the wall begins to blur, revealing it's a decoy setup.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 我早就不在建業了！
